scope: Independent read-only review of saved-structure window producer, strict receipt gate, fixture/full-report/state custody and PNG geometry/alpha admission. Authored local controls only; actual native CI receipt, RGB pixel appearance and visual acceptance remain separate. Decoder implementation is excluded from this independent review.
reviewed_boundaries: Generated fixture exact inventory, source/generator/report/manifest byte hashes and expected report shape.
Current helper identity, complete report hash/count and revision/selection/history bindings across clean, dirty and large phases.
Exact inspection/page/close request counts, complete read-only JSON text hash and scroll-to-end receipt.
Two client-root PNG captures with actual bytes, chunk CRC, decoded alpha, dimensions and DPI validation.
Minimum window geometry, report/footer containment and usable distinct tab geometry including wrapped headers.
Document/window suspension and owner lifecycle source flow; no source edits.

findings.original: Gate accepted overlapping tabs, one-DIP-square tabs and tabs over report content.
findings.correction: Tabs now require 40x24 DIP, Sections containment, pairwise nonoverlap and bottoms above report content, with wrapping permitted.

limitations: Authored receipt/PNG controls validate rejection logic, not actual native layout or behavior.
The gate measures geometry and alpha integrity; RGB appearance still requires image review.
Static source review and bounded controls cannot establish full application or reference fidelity.
